comments.subject: Public Comments Form
comments.comment:
I am writing to make ANOTHER complaint about the dog named Max that lives 24/7 in a kennel in the back of this guy's motor home. The address is [redacted]. We have notified Animal services, they said no laws are being broken. We have contacted PETA and they have sent the guy notice that GSD's need exercise and stimulation and suggested he take the tarp off the kennel so he can at least see outside of his pathetic 8x10 world.

This has gone on long enough. Who do we contact who will DO SOMETHING? This one year old dog, a beautiful German Shepard puppy, should be able to run and play and be socialized with people. He's a working dog, NOT A POSSESSION TO LOCK UP 24/7. I drive by every day and whistle. Sometimes he doesn't even get up to look, but other days he sticks his nose out of the bars and tries to see who might be coming to see him. This dog's spirit is broken and if he's going to have any chance at all, he needs to be taken out of this cage. I've seen the owner, Jeff, hit the dog if he barks and yell "I said no barking!" I saw his friend kick the dog and Max yelped.

Here is one picture. We have many more, taken day after day. He has been in this kennel for a couple of months, but before that he was in a cage that was approximately 4 ft by 4 ft. hardly enough room for a growing GSD. Are you going to do anything? Or is this just "a dog", so not important? Please tell me how I can help Max, if you can't or won't.

notes: Single JotForm submission complaining about a dog (Max) kept caged. Page 2 is the attached photo max.jpg. Address of complained-about party omitted.
